sqlPredicate: CASE WHEN (c.relname='speakers' AND a.attname='is_protagonist') OR (c.relname='script_entries' AND a.attname='body_search') THEN a.atthasdef AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad WHERE ad.adrelid=c.oid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum)=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad WHERE ad.adrelid=c.oid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid,false)=CASE WHEN c.relname='speakers' THEN 'false' ELSE 'lower(body)' END) ELSE NOT a.atthasdef AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad WHERE ad.adrelid=c.oid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum) END
